source: Global Hazard Data catalog.xlsx / sheet ' Data Schema'

columns.name: hazard_code
columns.title: Hazard code
columns.description: GCHD pipeline hazard code (CSV file stem); see config/hazard_map.yaml.

columns.name: unicef_code
columns.title: UNICEF hazard code
columns.description: UNICEF proposed / GLIDE code from the 'Hazard Codes' tab.

columns.name: source_release
columns.title: Source release
columns.description: Release date of the source CSVs.

columns.name: geo_level
columns.title: Geographic level
columns.description: Determines at what geographic level (global, country, region, etc).

columns.name: hazard
columns.title: Hazard type
columns.description: The hazard type that is being assessed.

columns.name: source
columns.title: Source
columns.description: GEE asset from  which hazard data was obtained.

columns.name: prod_date
columns.title: Production date
columns.description: The date when the data was produced.

columns.name: dataflow
columns.title: Data production flow identifier
columns.description: Data flow code according to UNICEF.

columns.name: time_period
columns.title: Time period
columns.description: Year or time period for which the data is produced.

columns.name: iso3
columns.title: ISO3 code
columns.description: ISO 3 code of the country

columns.name: adm0_id
columns.title: Administrative 0 ID
columns.description: Administrative level 0 (national level) unique ID.

columns.name: adm0_name
columns.title: Administrative 0 name
columns.description: Administrative level 0 (national level) readable name.

columns.name: adm0_ucode
columns.title: Administrative 0 code
columns.description: Administrative level 0 (national level) unique code.

columns.name: adm1_name
columns.title: Administrative 1 name
columns.description: Administrative level 1 (regional level) readable name.

columns.name: adm1_ucode
columns.title: Administrative 1 code
columns.description: Administrative level 1 (regional level) unique code.

columns.name: adm2_name
columns.title: Administrative 2 name
columns.description: Administrative level 2 (district level) readable name.

columns.name: adm2_ucode
columns.title: Administrative 2 code
columns.description: Administrative level 2 (district level) unique code.

columns.name: unicef_region
columns.title: UNICEF Region
columns.description: UNICEF region acronym.

columns.name: unicef_region_full
columns.title: UNICEF Region Full
columns.description: Complete name of the UNICEF region.

columns.name: hazs_mean
columns.title: Hazard mean
columns.description: Average intensity value of the hazard across the assessed administrative area. Higher numbers mean the physical danger is generally greater.

columns.name: hazs_std
columns.title: Hazard standard deviation
columns.description: How much the intensity varies within the assessed administrative area. A large value means some locations are much riskier than others.

columns.name: hazs_max
columns.title: Hazard maximum
columns.description: Highest hazard intensity within the administrative area. Higher values indicate severe localized impacts.

columns.name: hazs_min
columns.title: Hazard minimum
columns.description: Lowest hazard intensity within the administrative area. Lower values represent minimal hazard intensity.

columns.name: hazs_median
columns.title: Hazard median
columns.description: Middle value of hazard intensity when ranked from lowest to highest within the administrative area. Higher median refers to moderate–high intensity.

columns.name: gindex
columns.title: Global Hazard Severity Index
columns.description: A 0–10 index scaled using global minimum and maximum hazard intensity values. Higher values indicate more severe global hazard levels.

columns.name: cindex
columns.title: Country Hazard Severity Index
columns.description: A 0–10 index scaled using country-specific minimum and maximum hazard intensity values. Higher values indicate severe national-level hazard conditions.

columns.name: rindex
columns.title: Regional Hazard Severity Index
columns.description: A 0–10 index scaled using regional intensity extremes. Higher values reflect more severe regional hazard conditions.

columns.name: pop_total
columns.title: Total population
columns.description: Estimated number of people residing in an admin unit.

columns.name: pop_total_m
columns.title: Total male population
columns.description: Estimated number of male population residing in an admin unit.

columns.name: pop_total_f
columns.title: Total female population
columns.description: Estimated number of  female population residing in an admin unit.

columns.name: u18_pop_total
columns.title: Total children (under 18)
columns.description: Estimated number of children residing in an admin unit.

columns.name: u18_pop_m
columns.title: Total male children (under 18)
columns.description: Estimated number of boys under 18 residing in an admin unit.

columns.name: u18_pop_f
columns.title: Total female children (under 18)
columns.description: Estimated number of girls under 18 residing in an admin unit.

columns.name: aexp
columns.title: Total population exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated number of people residing in hazard-exposed areas.

columns.name: amexp
columns.title: Total male population exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated number of males residing in hazard-exposed areas.

columns.name: afexp
columns.title: Total female population exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated number of females residing in hazard-exposed areas.

columns.name: u18_aexp
columns.title: Total children (under 18) exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated number of children (under 18 years) residing in hazard-exposed areas.

columns.name: u18_amexp
columns.title: Total male children (under 18) exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated number of male children (under 18 years) residing in hazard-exposed areas.

columns.name: u18_afexp
columns.title: Total female children (under 18) exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated number of female children (under 18 years) residing in hazard-exposed areas.

columns.name: rexp
columns.title: Percentage of population exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated proportion of the total population of the administrative area residing in hazard-exposed areas.
columns.rollup: recomputed aexp/pop_total*100 over units with data

columns.name: rmexp
columns.title: Percentage of male population exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated proportion of all males in the administrative area residing in hazard-exposed areas.
columns.rollup: recomputed amexp/pop_total_m*100 over units with data

columns.name: rfexp
columns.title: Percentage of female population exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated proportion of all females in the administrative area residing in hazard-exposed areas.
columns.rollup: recomputed afexp/pop_total_f*100 over units with data

columns.name: u18_rexp
columns.title: Percentage of children (under 18) exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated proportion of all children (under 18) in the administrative area residing in hazard-exposed areas.
columns.rollup: recomputed u18_aexp/u18_pop_total*100 over units with data

columns.name: u18_rmexp
columns.title: Percentage of male children (under 18) exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated proportion of male children (under 18) in the administrative area residing in hazard-exposed areas.
columns.rollup: recomputed u18_amexp/u18_pop_m*100 over units with data

columns.name: u18_rfexp
columns.title: Percentage of male children (under 18) exposed to hazard
columns.description: Estimated proportion of female children (under 18) in the administrative area residing in hazard-exposed areas.
columns.rollup: recomputed u18_afexp/u18_pop_f*100 over units with data

columns.name: gexpi
columns.title: Global exposure index
columns.description: A 0–10 index that combines log-scaled absolute exposure and percentage-based relative exposure (each robust min–max normalised) via the geometric mean, identifying locations where both the number and proportion of people exposed are simultaneously high.
columns.aggregation: geometric mean of absolute and relative exposure
